notes.summary: voice.recordingBar.variant 'composer' shows the live words in the editor where the text goes, with a compact waveform next to the mic; the mic stops, Escape cancels.
notes.howTo: Set voice.recordingBar.variant to 'composer'. Style the live words with [data-element="placeholder"][data-live], textarea[data-live]::placeholder and [data-element="live-transcript"]; the waveform is [data-component="recording-bar"][data-variant="composer"]. CSS that hid toolbar buttons while the inline bar was mounted no longer applies.
